This is a bug report form for **Bonnibel's carrion userscripts**. If your bug is on mainsite, or happens while all the userscripts are disabled, report it on the discord and not here.

Provide a clear and concise description of what the bug is.

- Say what happened or what is happening, and what was unexpected about it.
- Include a screenshot if it will help.
- Which of our userscripts do you have installed?
- Which *other* userscripts do you have installed? Does this bug still happen if you disable them? (We still want to be compatible with other userscripts people may use.)
